what: A brand mark (20% of panel height, 16~120px) flies over the panel on a Lissajous curve (±42% of width at .55 rad/s, ±36% of height at .83 rad/s), always turning its head toward its direction of flight (9/s), and leaves 10 outlines along its path spaced at mark size ×.55 — toward the tail they shrink to 50% and fade (opacity .7 → .1). Each outline is a 1.2px text-color stroke over a 3.2px background-color border, so it stays crisp over clouds and photos. When the cursor enters the panel, the mark drops the curve and chases the cursor (follow 9/s, normally 4/s), and it hops 3.5% every 1.15s (canvas 2D)

options.gap: Gap between outlines (times the symbol size), default .55
options.base: Outline border (background) color variable, default --kf-bg. Symbols and lines use the text color (color)
options.[data-fx-part=mark]: Symbol shape — an svg with one path inside. If none, a rounded square

from.where: service.html Point cloud panel — a symbol flying over a gray cloud (warp-cloud-trail zoom 2.2)

note: The original pushes the spots the symbols pass through into a viscous flow field (64×64) to part the cloud below like water, but that coupling is dropped and only the symbol flight is extracted. With reduced motion: a single frozen frame, tail included, with the curve set 4 seconds ahead. On touch devices: no cursor chasing, curve only.
